source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of custom exceptions (PDF 61-62).

blocks.text: Custom exceptions se aap apne error types (ghaltiyon ki qismein) bana sakte hain jinhein raise kiya ja sake (yani ghalti paida ki ja sake) aur khaas tareeqe se handle kiya ja sake.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab check_value(-1) ko try : ke neeche margin par chhapti hai; aise IndentationError aata hai. Yeh line try block ke andar indented honi chahiye.

items: CustomError user ki banayi hui exception hai (Exception class se bani).
check_value() value negative (zero se kam) ho to raise se CustomError paida karta hai; except usay pakar kar "Error : Value must be non-negative ! " print karta hai.
class MyError(Exception): pass se nayi exception; raise se paida hoti, except se pakri jati hai.
